boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Available at the Box Office. Opens 1 hour before event. Please bring a picture ID, the actual credit card used to purchase the tickets and your order number.

venues.parkingDetail: Located in the lot on Monroe Street across from the center, South Hall Garage, and Clinton Avenue.

generalInfo.childRule: Varies depending on event. See individual events for age requirements.
